subheadline: Access, licensing and billing, answered by the people who handle them. For anything else, the subscriptions desk in Vienna replies within two working days.

items.question: What does a Reader plan include?
items.answer: For EUR 12 per month, one person gets all 9,800 papers in full text, saved searches and the Signal Weekly briefing. Downloads are unlimited and stay yours if you cancel.

items.question: Can my institution buy seats in bulk?
items.answer: Yes. Institutional access costs EUR 6,400 per year for 250 concurrent seats, with login by IP range or single sign-on. You get usage reports each quarter in COUNTER 5 format.

items.question: May I use a figure in teaching?
items.answer: Yes. Everything under CC BY-NC 4.0 may be used for non-commercial teaching if you credit the source. For commercial use, ask the rights desk. It replies within five working days.
